item.title: Research Agenda
item.description:
Core Research Interests

  • Artificial Intelligence and Society
  • Digital Governance
  • Political Economy
  • Marxist Political Economy
  • Public Policy Design
  • Computational Social Science

Current Questions

  • How does AI reshape production relations?
  • How do algorithmic systems influence governance capacity?
  • What forms of regulation are appropriate for platform economies?
  • How should states respond to emerging AI systems?

Long-Term Goal

To study the interaction between technology, institutions, and social organization, and contribute to policy-oriented research in digital governance and public policy.
